info.title: U.S. EPA Enforcement and Compliance History Online (ECHO) - Clean Air Tracking Tool Rest Services - Emission Screener
info.description: The ECATT Emission Screener (EMS) provides data on stationary sources regulated under the Clean Air Act.

q.output.name: output
q.output.description:
Output Format Flag.  Enter one of the following keywords:
- JSON = Data model formatted as Javascript Object Notation (default).
- JSONP = Data model formatted as Javascript Object Notation with Padding.  
- XML = Data model formatted as Extensible Markup Language.

f.p_owop.name: p_owop
f.p_owop.description:
Owner/Operator code filter. Enter one of the following values.

Federal = Federal facilities regulated under the NPDES program.
POTW = Publicly owned treatment works. Treatment works that are owned by a State, Tribe, or municipality.
Non-POTW = Non-publicly owned treatment works. Often referred to as "non-municipals" or "industrials".

ObjectId.title: Object Identifier
ObjectId.description: Sequential number assigned to each facility or cluster returned.

SearchYear.title: Search Year
SearchYear.description: The year selected in the search criteria.

PollutantName.title: Pollutant Name
PollutantName.description: The name of the pollutant with violations reported in the search year.

PollutantCategory.title: Polltuant Category
PollutantCategory.description: The name of the pollutant categories with violations reported in the search year.

FacCount.title: Count of Facilities Returned
FacCount.description: Displays the count of facilities returned based on the unique search.

NaicsCode.title: Facility NAICS Code
NaicsCode.description: The facility's North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) code.

NaicsDesc.title: Facility NAICS Description
NaicsDesc.description: The description of the North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) code associated with the facility.

RegistryId.title: FRS Registry ID
RegistryId.description: 12-digit Facility Registry Service (FRS) identification number.  FRS uniquely identifies a facility by assigning an identification number (FRS ID), and uses this FRS ID to link together all EPA regulatory program database records

FacName.title: Facility Name
FacName.example: W M A T A CENTRAL MAINT FAC

FacStreet.title: Facility Street
FacStreet.description: Street address where facility is located, as maintained by each data system. Certain data systems also maintain mailing address information, which is not used in this report. The street address may differ across EPA databases due to differences in reported information (e.g., use of mailing address), change in ownership, use of parent or subsidiary address, etc.

FacCity.title: Facility City
FacCity.description: The city where the facility is located.

FacCounty.title: Facility County
FacCounty.description: The county where the facility is located.

FipsCode.title: FIPS Code
FipsCode.description: A 5 digit combination of the 2 digit Federal Information Processing Standards (FIPS) code for the state and the 3 digit FIPS code of the county that a facility is located in.

FacEpaRegion.title: Facility EPA Region
FacEpaRegion.description: The EPA region in which the facility is located

FacRpo.title: Regional Planning Organization (RPO)
FacRpo.description: One of the five EPA funded RPOs to address air quality issues in which the facility is located.

FacLat.title: Latitude
FacLat.description: The latitude of the facility in decimal degrees expressed using the NAD83 horizontal datum. The coordinate comes from the FRS EPA Locational Reference Tables (LRT) file which represents the most accurate value for the facility based on the available spatial metadata.

FacLong.title: Longitude
FacLong.description: The longitude of the facility in decimal degrees expressed using the NAD83 horizontal datum. The coordinate comes from the FRS EPA Locational Reference Tables (LRT) file which represents the most accurate value for the facility based on the available spatial metadata.

PopulationDensity.title: Population Density
PopulationDensity.description: The number of persons per square mile in the area being profiled. This field is the ratio of total persons (displayed in the Total Persons field) to total land area (displayed in the Land Area field)

OzoneNonAttainment.title: Ozone Nonattainment Area
OzoneNonAttainment.description: Indicates whether the facility is in a nonattainment area for ozone according to the national ambient air quality standards.

PmNonAttainment.title: Particulate Matter Nonattainment Area
PmNonAttainment.description: Indicates whether the facility is in a nonattainment area for particulate matter according to the national ambient air quality standards.

LeadNonAttainment.title: Lead Nonattainment Area
LeadNonAttainment.description: Indicates whether the facility is in a nonattainment area for lead according to the national ambient air quality standards.

So2NonAttainment.title: Sulfur Dioxide (SO2) Nonattainment Area
So2NonAttainment.description: Indicates whether the facility is in a nonattainment area for sulfur dioxide (SO2) according to the national ambient air quality standards.

TribeDistance.title: Distance to Tribal Lands
TribeDistance.description: The distance from the facility to the nearest tribal lands.

NaicsCodes.title: NAICS Codes
NaicsCodes.description: Indicates the facility's North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) Codes.

NeiSccs.title: NEI SCC Codes
NeiSccs.description: Source Classification Code from the National Emission Inventory (NEI).

EisTypes.title: EIS Types
EisTypes.description: Facility Classification from the Emissions Inventory System (EIS).

GhgTypes.title: GHG Facility Types
GhgTypes.description: The Greenhouse Gas Reporting Program facility classification.

GhgSubparts.title: GHG Subparts
GhgSubparts.description: The Greenhouse Gas Reporting Program subpart the facility is subject to.

AirSourceClassification.title: Air Source Classification

The field is calculated by subtracting the number of persons who are white (and not of Hispanic origin) from the total persons. This number is then divided by the total persons and multiplied by one hundred to determine the percentage.
